en.text: Give ear to my words, LORD. my meditation.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的言語，

en.text: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

zhSimplified.text: 我的王我的 神啊，求你垂听我呼求的声音！

zhTraditional.text: 我的王我的上帝啊，求你垂聽我呼求的聲音！

en.text: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，早晨你必听我的声音； ，并要警醒！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，早晨你必聽我的聲音； ，並要警醒！

en.text: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. with you.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你不是喜悦恶事的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 因為你不是喜悅惡事的上帝，

en.text: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前；

zhTraditional.text: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前；

en.text: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，我必凭你丰盛的慈爱进入你的居所；

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，我必憑你豐盛的慈愛進入你的居所；

en.text: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. your way straight before my face.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，凭你的公义引领我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，憑你的公義引領我，

en.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，他们的口中没有诚实；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，他們的口中沒有誠實；

en.text: Hold them guilty, God. them fall by their own counsels. them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，求你定他們的罪！

en.text: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. them always shout for joy, because you defend them. them also who love your name be joyful in you.

zhSimplified.text: 凡投靠你的，愿他们喜乐，时常欢呼，

zhTraditional.text: 凡投靠你的，願他們喜樂，時常歡呼，

en.text: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
